text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's strange. I should have at least 
scored a few.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, don't they say failure is the mother 
of success? Think of this as the first 
step toward the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And so, let us move on to testing the new 
drug! This one induces a sort of hypnotic 
state—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Crap! I left it in the lab... Alright, 
heading back!
It ended in a disappointing result...
